claims.claim_text: I observed a male subject standing on the concrete walkway outside the courtyard gate. The subject was in full view and matched the description provided by dispatch.
The subject held a beverage can in his left hand throughout the encounter.
The subject placed his left hand in his front jacket pocket, turned his back to me, and began walking toward the enclosed patio area.
The subject stated he was there to visit a friend and asked me to call my supervisor.
Corporal Fuentes deployed his Taser, striking the subject in the chest. The subject fell forward onto his stomach within the enclosed patio area.
I approached the threshold of the patio and observed the subject lying face down.
Corporal Fuentes was approximately ten feet to my right.
The subject then reached toward his left waistband with his right hand and produced what appeared to be a black semi-automatic handgun.
The subject raised the weapon and pointed it in my direction.
I discharged my duty weapon, firing approximately twelve rounds.
The weapon was later identified as a Glock 22, .40-caliber handgun, registered to the subject.
At approximately 2136 hours, dispatch received a 9-1-1 call from a female resident (W-1) reporting that an unknown male was kicking her front door and demanding entry.
I identified myself as a police officer and ordered the subject to approach me with his hands visible.
Officer Pistilli arrived on scene and secured the weapon from the subject's immediate reach. Officer Pistilli handcuffed the subject and applied a tourniquet to the subject's upper left thigh.
W-1 described the male as wearing a jacket, mask, beanie, and dark brown work boots.
